note: One table per column-window rule (#1645); the refusal lists every broken window and leaves Good and Overlap alone. Good: the key column's two disjoint windows on two variants, with no delivery between them, and a field windowed on one variant. Overlap: two variants' windows of one column overlap, which the same mappings without windows may too.
fails_if: a window reaching outside its table's edition or across the gap of an interrupted edition, a windowed coordinate mapped again in its column, an inverted window, a window on a member, or a window in a year-independent table stops being refused under inventory_window_invalid, or a valid set of disjoint windows with a gap, or overlapping windows of one column on two variants, is refused
